title: Approved Software Policy
description: Venue-wide allow-list governing which installed applications are permitted on game PCs. Evaluated server-side against each agent's full installed-software inventory (machine_state). Anything not matched by an allow rule is unapproved: Phase 2 flags it (report-only); Phase 4 may queue a remove_software job for operator-approved or policy-auto removal. Separate contract from the Master Manifest, which stays two-part.

default_action.description: Venue-wide default for unapproved apps. report_only = dashboard/alert only (Phase 2 baseline). flag_for_removal = removable after operator approves per-item. auto_remove = server may queue remove_software jobs unattended; must be an explicit operator choice per venue.

allow.description: Allow-list rules. An installed app is approved if any rule matches. Matching keys are ANDed within a rule.

name_prefix.description: Optional DisplayName prefix, e.g. 'Microsoft Visual C++ 20' to cover redistributables.

protected.description: Hard removal veto, evaluated even under auto_remove and independent of allow-list matching. Matches by name/name_prefix/publisher like allow rules. Baseline expectations: device drivers, Windows components, security products, EsportsUtil agent, and approved launcher/infrastructure apps.

idle_window.description: Optional local-time window during which remove_software jobs may run on idle machines, e.g. '02:00-08:00'. Absent = idle-detection only (no active game session, no foreground user activity).
